item.title: New contemporary art gallery coming to Oxford Street, focus on local creatives

item.title: Four new public schools, major upgrades for others on the way for growing Perth suburbs
item.description: Four new public primary schools and major upgrades to existing campuses are on the way, as Perth’s rapidly growing suburbs continue to put pressure on classrooms. The State Government this week announced $230 million in funding for new schools and significant upgrades across Western Australia, with four new primary schools set to open in 2028…

item.title: Wicked star and jazzman Jeff Goldblum is touring Perth this year
item.description: For the first time ever, jazz wizard Jeff Goldblum will be touring Australia this year – and bringing along his longtime collaborators The Mildred Snitzer Orchestra. item.title: “Extremely shy” fish spotted near Albany
item.description: Measuring less than 7.5cm and described by researchers as “extremely shy”, an incredibly rare fish has been spotted by UWA researchers in a kelp forest off the coast of Albany. item.description: First launching in 2022, Perth Design Week is gearing up to return this March – with a huge program that showcases Australian design across architecture, landscaping and planning, interiors, furniture, fashion, graphic design and more.
